channel.title: Willow Glen Dispatch
channel.description: Willow Glen and central San Jose news, once a week, from the Willow Glen Dispatch.

item.title: San Jose declared a local emergency for the El Niño storm season before the worst of it arrives
item.description: The City Council proclaimed it on November 10, after new National Weather Service predictions and talks with Valley Water about flood risk along the city's creeks and rivers.

item.title: Household batteries go out with the recycling starting January 4
item.description: Single-family homes can put alkaline AA, AAA, C, D and 9-volt batteries, plus button and coin cells, in a clear quart-size resealable bag on top of the recycling cart on collection day.

item.title: Opening a restaurant in San Jose gets a faster permit path on January 1
item.description: The city's Streamline Restaurant Program becomes the standard permit route for restaurant and food-and-beverage build-outs.

item.title: free sandbags
item.description: Valley Water hands out free filled sandbags to Santa Clara County residents from November 1 through April 15.
